caption: The drawing depicts an ornate rectangular mirror with a detailed frame. The frame is predominantly a reddish-brown color with gold trim, featuring elaborate scrollwork and curving details at the top and bottom. At the very top center, there is a gold eagle or bird figure with outstretched wings, set above a gold oval medallion. The upper portion of the mirror is separated from the lower by a horizontal gold line, creating two sections within the reflective area. The background is a plain, off-white color with a faint rectangular border drawn around the mirror, indicating the boundaries of the drawing area. The mirror itself is rendered with a light blue tint, suggesting reflectivity. There are no other objects or figures present in the composition.
title: Mirror
